_comment: Cross-engine parity contract for the clip source-PTS algorithm.
Single source of truth shared by BOTH video engines:
Each engine has a test that reads this file and asserts it reproduces every case,
so the two implementations can never drift silently.
Scope: these cases are intentionally frame-rate-independent (no frameRate) and use
an explicit positive sourceRangeDurationSec, the region where both engines are
specified to agree exactly. The readable-tail guard is a flat guardSec here.
KNOWN INTENTIONAL DIVERGENCE (NOT covered by this fixture):
When the web engine is given a clip frameRate, clampToLastReadableSourceTicks() pulls
the readable tail back by half a frame instead of guardSec, because the web path
seeks an exact PTS via mediabunny, whereas the native path snaps to the nearest
decoded frame. See source-time.parity.test.ts ('web-only half-frame guard').
